name: casestack
description: Transform raw project material into portfolio case studies for UX and product designers at every level with structured content, gap-fill interviews, and production-ready Next.js pages.

skills.name: case-study
skills.description: Main entry point for creating portfolio case studies. Routes to ingest, interview, write, and generate sub-skills.

skills.name: case-study/ingest
skills.description: Ingest project material (docs, PDFs, Figma files, notes) and extract structured content.

skills.name: case-study/interview
skills.description: Gap-fill interview to capture missing case-study content, prioritized by designer level.

skills.name: case-study/write
skills.description: Generate case study content following writing rules, in the tone for the designer's level.

skills.name: case-study/architecture
skills.description: Reference for case-study architecture and what hiring managers look for.

skills.name: case-study/style-presets
skills.description: Select presentation style preset based on content type (Interactive Narrative, Editorial, Data/Metrics, Visual Campaign, Design System Doc).

skills.name: case-study/page-generator
skills.description: Generate Next.js case study pages matching the portfolio's existing conventions and selected style preset.

skills.name: case-study/review
skills.description: Score case study against the rubric for the designer's level and verify build/accessibility.
